description: The bar chart, titled "Accuracy (%)", illustrates the performance of four different reasoning methods—CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—across two metrics: accuracy percentage and token count. The horizontal axis categorizes the methods, with each method represented by a distinct color: CoT (red), CoD (orange), CCoT (light blue), and CoUT (green). The left vertical axis measures accuracy in percentage, ranging from 70% to 100%, while the right vertical axis measures token count, ranging from 0 to 800. The chart displays two sets of bars for each method: the height of the left bar indicates the accuracy, and the height of the right bar indicates the token count. The data shows that CoT achieves the highest accuracy at 91.19%, but also has the highest token count at 676.85. CoD has the lowest accuracy at 80.89% and a token count of 534.24. CCoT has an accuracy of 88.50% and a token count of 445.91. CoUT has an accuracy of 88.40% and a token count of 354.46. The bars are arranged in descending order of accuracy, with CoT being the tallest for accuracy and CoT also being the tallest for token count.
